Hello class,

I've uploaded 4 videos with coding vignettes on how to train neural networks using Pytorch, Pytorch Lightning, and google colab notebooks. 
I created a basic neural network and trained it to classify images of clothing items from the FashionMNIST dataset. The live notebook had some
issues saving/crashing, so apologies I switched to the 'official' notebook halfway in.
